ingredients.name: beans, 14 ounce, kidney, black-eyed or chickpeas, in brine
mackerel fillets in tomato sauce, 4 ounce

steps.instruction: Open the cans of beans, tomatoes and mackerel.
Drain the liquid from the beans.
Add the beans, tomatoes and mackerel to a saucepan.
Add 1 teaspoon of curry powder, and salt and pepper to taste.
Cover and simmer for 5 minutes, stirring now and then.
steps.spoken: Cover and simmer for 5 to 10 minutes, stirring now and then, until it is hot enough to eat.
